caption: Kuangstradamus · the oracle of fantasy football
speech: Kuangstradamus. The oracle of fantasy football.

caption: Ask the Oracle about any trade.
speech: Ask it about any trade, in plain English. What you give, then the word for, then what you get.

caption: Players resolve on the free Sleeper feed. No paid data anywhere.
speech: Every name resolves on Sleeper's free feed. There is no paid data anywhere in this app.

caption: Value above a free replacement, not raw points. The seal is the verdict.
speech: The verdict is not raw points. It is value above a free replacement at each position, which is how a two-for-one should be judged. The seal is the call: even, slight, clear, or a fleecing.

caption: Open the slip: rest-of-season points, rank, bye, flags.
speech: Open the slip for each player: rest-of-season points, positional rank, bye week, and anything the model is nervous about.

caption: The Almanac imports any Sleeper league.
speech: The Almanac imports any Sleeper league, from a username or a league ID.

caption: Standings with playoff odds and luck.
speech: Standings carry playoff odds from a Monte Carlo over the remaining schedule, and luck: your actual wins against what the all-play record says you deserved.

caption: Positional strength as a heat grid: jade above the league, violet below.
speech: Positional strength is a heat grid. Jade means above the league average, violet means below. There is no legend to decode.

caption: …and your day page opens on what matters this week.
speech: From then on, the Almanac opens on your day page. Six lines of positional strength, eighteen weeks of byes, the trade deadline and the playoffs, and today's reading.

caption: Three readings: lineup, waivers, the next date that matters.
speech: Three readings. Your lineup. The waiver you should bid on, and what it should cost. And the next date that matters. One number each.

caption: Slips open one at a time for a single answer.
speech: Below them are slips. One opens at a time, and each answers one question.

caption: Every player opens a sheet: value, this week's gates, FAAB from your league's own bids.
speech: Every player opens a sheet: what he is worth in this league, this week's gates, and a FAAB estimate learned from your league's own winning bids.

caption: Trade targets come with a partner and an offer, and hand the Oracle the question.
speech: Trade targets come with a partner, the hole they fill, and a button that hands the Oracle the question.

caption: No offer was suggested here, so we name one.
speech: No offer was suggested for this one, so we name a player to give.

caption: Scored in your league's own rules, prefilled from the Almanac.
speech: Scored in your league's own rules this time, prefilled straight from the Almanac.

caption: The season ledger: odds, luck, efficiency, schedule.
speech: And the season ledger: odds, luck, lineup efficiency, and the schedule ahead. Everything is a mark first and a table second.

caption: kuangstradamus.xyz · free Sleeper data · your week, read first
speech: Kuangstradamus. Free data, your week read first. The oracle reads probabilities, not certainties. Set your own lineup.
